message.reasoning:
We need to produce a test class for getBarSeries method. Use JUnit5, Mockito. Need to initialize a NumericIndicator instance with a delegate indicator that has a BarSeries. We can use MockBarSeries or a real series. In existing tests they use MockBarSeries and ClosePriceIndicator. But we can simplify.

Goal: test that NumericIndicator.getBarSeries() returns delegate's series.

We need to set up fields: BarSeries series; Indicator<Num> delegate; NumericIndicator numericIndicator.

We need to use numFunction from AbstractIndicatorTest? Not needed; we can use a simple Number to Num conversion using DefaultNum? The library uses Num interface; we can use org.ta4j.core.num.DecimalNum? Might need to use a static method. But we can avoid numeric values; just need series.

We can create a mock Indicator<Num> using Mockito, stub getBarSeries() to return a mock BarSeries. Then create NumericIndicator via reflection? The constructor is protected, but there is static method NumericIndicator.of(delegate). Use that.

So in setupBeforeEach, create mock BarSeries, mock Indicator<Num>, stub getBarSeries().

Test method: when numericIndicator.getBarSeries() called, returns same series.

Also test that if delegate returns null? Not needed.

Add imports.

Write class with @Test method.

Use @ExtendWith(MockitoExtension.class) to inject mocks.

Define @Mock BarSeries mockSeries; @Mock Indicator<Num> mockIndicator;

In setupBeforeEach, numericIndicator = NumericIndicator.of(mockIndicator);

Set up when(mockIndicator.getBarSeries()).thenReturn(mockSeries);

Test.

Also test that calling getBarSeries multiple times returns same.

Add teardown methods empty.

Return final code.
